_comment: e109 — a network where people mine AI results. Machine values and the market numbers it is measured against live here, never in code.

machine.label: vuos-hcar5000mi (Ryzen 5 5625U, 12 threads, no discrete GPU)
machine.biz: Dana's Air (sample HVAC contractor, Austin TX)
machine.price_book: diagnostic 89 waived with repair; capacitor 180-260; fan motor 380-560; R-410A 45/lb; after-hours +120

_api_note: measured in e108/costo.py on glm-5.3-flash, warm cache, same workflow

settlement.reason: no new L1: the chain anchors a batch root and settles USDC; it cannot verify inference
settlement.anchor_cost_note: base fee 5000 lamports, measured 2026-11-10 (priority fees were 0)

pricing._feed_note: public catalogue, per-token prices, no key. Cached 1h in data/precios.json; every quote is recomputable from (tokens, feed).
pricing._model_note: the cheapest model that passes the workflow's quality floor, chosen from the feed, not typed in. A premium model is a separate axis, not an ownership tier.

cost._what: work at cost + network fee. No ownership, no lock-in.

cobuild._what: 3x cost: the client is named as co-builder of the component and earns 15% of every reuse.

owner._what: 10x cost: the client is a named co-owner and earns 40% of every reuse, forever.

royalty._note: a reuse fee splits: sponsor (the client's chosen tier share) + builder (40%) + network (20%). Non-transferable, per-client contract.

_legacy_api_cost_note: api_cost_usd_per_job was a constant copied from one vendor page; superseded by pricing.feed_url (live) - measured 5.7x too expensive.

eval._note: a cheaper model replaces the incumbent only if every acceptance check passes on every case AND it wins or ties >=45% of pairwise judgements

energy._note: NEVER used for pricing. Pricing is the market price of the output. This is only the miner's own profit readout; set it from the electricity bill, or leave it empty (unknown stays empty).
